card.name: Policies of a named leader or government
card.fires_on: The word policy or policies (also measures) right after a leader's name or possessive, or after economic or fiscal. Mostly political and economic commentary on web text.

modes.label: Leader's policies
modes.description: Policy or policies after a possessive naming a politician or leader.
modes.example: The next President will be Obama again, continuing his<< policies>> of moderation, or Republican, Willard

modes.label: Economic policy terms
modes.description: Policy, policies or stimulus after an economic or fiscal adjective.
modes.example: As economic conditions worsened in the early 1980s, however, the FDP returned to its earlier advocacy of economic<< policies>> more conservative than those endorsed by the SPD

card.writes: It pushes policy-type nouns such as measures, policies and policy as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on the word policy or policies when a leader's or government's course of action is being discussed.
